Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
Have you made any arrangements with American publishers about my [Scripture Readings](/book/87)? I think I might perhaps do so, but I should like first to know whether you have any views.
[Miss Sewell](/person/1301) is very anxious to know when the [selections](/book/82) are to come.
I suspect you are from home.

Yours truly

C M Yonge
